name: Global Node Translation
description: creates translations in all enabled languages when a node is created.
project_description:
The Global Node Translation module creates translations in the enabled languages when a node is created in the original language.

 Features 
 
 Automatic translation of nodes across multiple languages using the stichoza/google-translate-php library. 
 Handles the translation of paragraph reference fields. 
 Includes support for Views Bulk Operations (VBO) with a Translate Nodes action, enabling bulk translation of nodes directly from the Views interface. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 1. Navigate to Administration > Extend and search for "Global Node Translation" module.

2. Under the Global Node Translation Module, you will find a configure link, here you can select the languages you want to create translations for.

3. Go to Administration > Configuration > Regional and Language > Content language and translation.

4. Enable the content types and fields that you want to be translatable.

5. After enabling the content types, the module provides an option to enable automatic translation for each content type.

6. Navigate to the content type settings page.

7. Find the "Enable Automatic Translate" option under language settings.

8. Check the option to enable automatic translation for this content type.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires no module outside of the drupal core.
